text: APPROVE. The extraction into `IsConstructorParen` and `ReadMemberToken` keeps every branch's effect on `decorated` and `members` the same (including the `&=` rewrite of the `}` reset and the unchanged-`decorated` fall-through), and my estimate of the remaining method's cognitive complexity is about 14, under the threshold of 15. I found nothing that would break the build, though I haven't run it, and I am assuming `tokens` is already an `IReadOnlyList<JsToken>` since that part of the file isn't in the diff.
